BiblicalUsage: Zabbud is named once, in Ezra 8:14. In Ezra 8:14 we read, "Of the sons also of Bigvai; Uthai, and Zabbud, and with them seventy males."
TheologicalSignificance: Zabbud is one more sign that the genealogies are God's way of saying he remembers.
